home.headline: Skip the wait. Know your turn.
home.step1: Join the Merkato, University, or Awetu line.
home.step2: Watch your place move as people board.
home.step3: Board when your minibus is called.
home.footer: Jimma lines: Merkato, University, Awetu, Jiren, Hospital, Hermata, Bishishe, and the bus station.
home.footerBlurb: A shared-taxi queue for Jimma. Join a line, watch your place, and board when your minibus is called.
home.how1Body: Pick the line you are taking, from Merkato, the university, Awetu, and the other Jimma stations.
home.how2Body: Your place is saved. Passengers who need help boarding are called first.
home.how3Body: The screen shows how many people are ahead of you. You get a message when your taxi is ready.
home.featureQueue: Join a route queue from your phone

home.featureRoles: Drivers, station staff, and admins work from the same queue
home.trustBody: Passengers, drivers, and station staff look at the same queue. Priority boarding is marked. You do not have to shout across the station to know your place.
